capabilities: visualize the vault as nodes orbiting parent nodes in layered systems
derive parent-child links from frontmatter, tags, outlinks, or backlinks
focus on a node and have the camera follow it while dimming unrelated nodes
customize theme, orbit speed, radius, node size, and toggles for traces and lines
disambiguation: Not a task or habit-tracking tool; despite the name, it renders the vault as an animated orbital graph of note relationships.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's graph view shows a static force-directed link web with no hierarchy, making parent-child structure between notes hard to see.
summary: Renders the vault as an animated orbital system where child notes circle parent nodes derived from frontmatter, tags, or links.
